text:
Nora Kim: Quick async - launch post + webinar landing go live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need a tiny SEO ops checklist: canonical preference, internal link targets, redirect fallbacks for promo links, and JSON-LD for Event + FAQ. Can we lock in owners now? @Eliot @Priya

Eliot Park: I can handle the crawl and internal-link plan. Will return top 6 inbound pages and suggested anchors in 30m.

Priya Patel: I'll prepare the JSON-LD blocks (Event + FAQ) and put them into /docs/seo/snippets. Also will A/B FAQ visibility for 2 weeks.

Sam Wu: Redirects: we still have /promo/may-leads and partner variants with ?ref=partner. Plan: edge strip known tracking params and 301 -> /product/leadflow. For staging smoke use 302. I'll stage the nginx snippet.

Jordan Lee: Keyword decision: primary = "inbound lead routing" (H1), secondary = "lead routing". Keep exact-match H1.

Eliot Park: Crawl snapshot - recommend linking from: /docs/getting-started (anchor: "set up inbound lead routing"), /integrations ("Leadflow integrations"), /partners/ ("partner lead routing"), /support/rules ("routing rules guide"), /pricing/limits ("Leadflow pricing"), /blog/ops-insights ("lead routing best practices").

Nora Kim: Great. Sam/Jordan/Priya - confirm who will push which change to the release branch?

Sam Wu: I'll push redirect rules to staging as 302s and run smoke tests. Snippet: rewrite ^/promo/may-leads/?$ /product/leadflow? redirect; then swap to permanent after green smoke. Will coordinate with infra for edge param stripping.

Priya Patel: JSON-LD example I'll include (short form) in the snippet doc: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Leadflow webinar","startDate":"2026-07-08T17:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/leadflow"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.ai/register/leadflow"}} plus an FAQPage block with three Qs (register, integrations, cancel).

Jordan Lee: Add BreadcrumbList to the article template and set canonical link rel to /product/leadflow on any campaign clones. That will help consolidate signals.

Eliot Park: I'll update the internal-links sheet and assign owners for each inbound page. Will also push the new URL into the weekly sitemap and ping Search Console after deploy.

Nora Kim: Priority list for tonight's deploy: 1) Redirect rules (Sam) 2) JSON-LD blocks in templates (Priya) 3) Internal links + sitemap (Eliot) 4) Canonical headers on campaign clones (Jordan) 5) Postlaunch checks + SERP monitoring (Priya).

Sam Wu: Confirmed. I'll open PR in 20m and target staging deploy in 1h.

Priya Patel: Confirmed. Snippets saved to /docs/seo/snippets and linked in PR. Will monitor rich results and impressions for 7 days.

Jordan Lee: Confirmed. I'll ensure CDN respects canonical headers and doesn't cache query variants as separate cache keys.

Nora Kim: Awesome. Postlaunch check-ins at +2h and +24h. If anything urgent, jump into #marketing-urgent. Closing thread.
